card.name: Page and book citation details
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in book-related text: page numbers ("On page", "p."), page counts, illustration counts, and copyright or reproduction notices.

modes.label: Page references
modes.description: The word page or the abbreviation p. just before a page number.

modes.label: Book catalog details
modes.description: Punctuation or spaces in publisher listings of page counts, illustrations, and dimensions.

modes.label: Reproduction notices
modes.description: Words in copyright statements about reproducing a book.
modes.example: All rights reserved including the right of reproduction in whole or in<< part>> in any form.

card.writes: It suppresses picture and book words, so it seems to steer away from naming books or pictures next.
card.plain: It fires on page numbers, page counts and copyright lines in book listings and citations.
